task.summary: Default task
Added 2x test cases for ability testing. Added safety check for curve not being set in sequence.
Ran formatter on several files. no changes.
Disabled debug mesh saving.
Sequence must wait for cooldown to end.
Added scaled time to main. Stop compiling after 1 error.
Editor settings
Editor settings
Removed unused enum from switch.
ref use is_null change
Reduced wall pushaway effect on entities. This stops them from being shoved from walls so strongly.
Animation player sword swings for melee.

Fixed a bug where units would zip across non-floors. This was due to player pathfinding having a backup condition that pulls things in if there is no valid path finding, such as off map. Now if units are not on floors they ignore this force. Added a way to disable player floor collision.
Added big slam for melee weapons. Added new walls for prototyping. Added GridMap support for floors and quickly generating a scene.
Small changes to wall2. Outside edges are not correct.

Added prototype player animated body. ActivatorNodes now signal player controller to melee attack animation. AbilityNode_World returns new activation context type. Player body now rotates based on animation or movement direction.
Moved Ortho plane to a new static class which can be accessed from gdscript.

Corrected gdscript function namespace for OrthoPlaneGenerator. Added Viewport vars to GameMainNode Added global config camera offsets to simplify multiple cameras. Cleaned up several scenes with which cameras/lights use which layers. projection_light_renderer_system.tscn updated with layers and added documentation notes which explains the system.
Expanded camera_main.tscn to have two new cameras with subviewports and configuration related to setup and positioning. While visually the camera position appears unchanged the big changes are - Floors are now properly at 0.0 - body is minimally offset up to correct this. - Cameras are now offset slightly to aim at center mass of body.

Added shader for player rendering. Added limited FPS rendering for player character. Added signals to update it.
Fixed nuisance warning in has_resources.
Removed tool from scripts for light setting - this should stop nuisance light levels in git changes.
Quick switch fix with default misspell.
Quick switch fix with default misspell.

Partial refactor of resource units. Resource pools now use quantized units. Added test function to easily set player resource pool vaules. Adding some debug logging which can be turned off. Rewrote ContinuousRegen function for units.

Completed refactor. - Player abilities now use same units as resource pools. - Fixed but in resource pools where nearly finished items were ignored. - Fixed bug where items are sometimes nearly charged but technically not completely.

Simple group spawn for mobs and a time based system to spawn groups based on how long the game has been running.
This is a very primitive system. Added lights to player body. Added basic enemy attacks back to enemies.
Enemy bugs now spawn a separate attack with visual element. Added new flec prefab type FlecPrefab_EnemyProjectile
Added basic damage accumulators with player damage sounds. Deleted old unused sounds.
Added basic damage accumulators with player damage sounds. Deleted old unused sounds.
Fixed held inventory item being behind UI.
Added beginnings of a global config. Currently set to inventory only.
Fixed issue in serializer where vector types could not be serialized. Also removed null base types from output.
Made item modifiers a proper array. Modified player attacks and scene for gameplay testing. Allows decimal units for radius.

Small and ugly changes to movement code. - Added smooth facing directions for movement. - Moved inputs from gdscript to cpp. - Added jumping (space) - Separated player pathfind map to a timer instead of player movement.
Pretty print godot prefabs as they load for easier debugging.
Added player slowdown when very close to enemies.
Added contact damage for player.
When player contacts enemies they are pushed away.
Player does not take damage while jumping from collision.
Fixed issues with game tests. - Bug with accessing normal componet without checking. - doctest now prints a simpler format when things fail.
Fixed issues with game tests. - Bug with accessing normal componet without checking. - doctest now prints a simpler format when things fail.
Large update to level loading. Moved some game_main_node aspects to a new node which can be swapped. Reduced headers used in common nodes.
Level now loads after start.
Changes to structure around level node and game main node. Levels can now be loaded through 'set_loaded_level'
Annoying refactor of moving player inventory out from level. Much of the UI for items remains in place. FOR NOW.
Added new static singleton getters for many types. This has no functional changes but does improve error logging for when these are accessed improperly.
FlecRenderingServer garbage cleanup and mild attempt at fixing loading issues. Loading is still very choppy.
Added unit tests for fixed bugs related to level loading.

Moved spawner prefab load to enter tree to help prevent unloading of assets. Re-added import files and set to uncompressed vram. This has significant load savings. Added signal for loading completed. Loading screen uses this and fades out.

Adding debug logging to level load. Cached reference to resources to prevent accidental unloading.
Switch textures to vram uncompressed Debug build - lossless load time : 4.5~ seconds, vram uncompressed 2.5s~ Release build - lossless load time : 0.7~ seconds, vram uncompressed 0.5s~
Store references so things don't unload. Debug Build : 1st Load - 3.0s, 2nd load 2.2s, 3rd+ load 1.4s Release build - 1st load - 0.6s , 2nd+ load 0.4s
Added debug print for when resources are unloaded.
